_note: The Primorska village (sl · en) before the culture pack: every text CultureProbes made from the code at the commit that added this file, before the game's content moved into companion/cultures/primorska. CultureParityTest wants the same texts from the pack. Never regenerate it from newer code: content added since (the mill, project/mlin; the chest's readings, chest/read and reading/; the spots' own texts, the charcoal pile and the high seat, spot/) adds its own probes, and never changes one that was here.

probes.quest/0/story: Babica Micka peče potico, a je pozabila nekaj besed. Spomni jo! · Grandma Micka is baking potica, but she has forgotten a few words. Remind her!
probes.quest/1/story: V nedeljo pride na kosilo vsa družina. Babica Micka potrebuje prave besede za mizo. · The whole family comes to lunch on Sunday. Grandma Micka needs the right words for the table.
probes.quest/2/title: Gostje pri Micki · Guests at Micka's
probes.quest/2/story: K babici Micki pridejo gostje iz Nemčije. Kako jih pozdravimo po slovensko? · Guests from Germany are coming to Grandma Micka's. How do we greet them in Slovene?
probes.quest/3/story: Mlinar France je izgubil seznam za mlin. Pomagaj mu vse spet poimenovati. · Miller France lost his list for the mill. Help him name everything again.
probes.quest/4/story: Žetev je tu! Vsaka prava beseda je snop na kozolcu. · The harvest is here! Every right word is a sheaf on the hayrack.
probes.quest/5/story: Čebelar Anton toči med. Vsaka prava beseda je žlica medu. · Beekeeper Anton is extracting honey. Every right word is a spoonful of honey.
probes.quest/6/story: Kranjska sivka je mirna čebela, a govori tiho. Prisluhni ji z Antonom. · The Carniolan bee is gentle, but it speaks quietly. Listen to it with Anton.
probes.quest/7/story: Pastir Luka kliče čez dolino. Kaj pravi? · Shepherd Luka calls across the valley. What is he saying?
probes.quest/8/story: Ena ovca je zbežala v Trnovski gozd. Luka jo kliče, poslušaj z njim. · One sheep has run off into the Trnovo forest. Luka is calling it, listen with him.
probes.quest/9/title: Zvonci v megli · Bells in the fog
probes.quest/9/story: V megli Luka ne vidi črede, sliši samo zvonce. Pomagaj mu poslušati. · In the fog Luka cannot see the flock, he only hears the bells. Help him listen.
probes.quest/10/story: Teta Ančka posluša Radio Koper, a slabo sliši. Povej ji, kaj so rekli. · Aunt Ančka is listening to Radio Koper, but she does not hear well. Tell her what they said.
probes.quest/11/title: Od kod so tujci? · Where are the strangers from?
probes.quest/11/story: Teta Ančka je slišala, da so v vas prišli tujci. Poslušaj z njo, od kod so. · Aunt Ančka heard that strangers came to the village. Listen with her to where they are from.
probes.quest/12/story: Kovač Tone potrebuje natančne stavke za naročila iz Gorice. Vsaka končnica šteje. · Smith Tone needs exact sentences for his orders from Gorizia. Every ending counts.
probes.quest/13/title: Podkev za konja · A horseshoe for the horse
probes.quest/13/story: Tone kuje podkev. Železo mora biti trdo, stavek pa pravilen. · Tone is forging a horseshoe. The iron must be hard, and the sentence correct.
probes.quest/14/story: Tone popravlja stari plug. Vsak del mora biti na pravem mestu, kot besede v stavku. · Tone is repairing an old plough. Every part must be in the right place, like the words in a sentence.
probes.quest/15/story: Učiteljica Mojca preverja končnice. Ali se tvoje besede ujemajo? · Teacher Mojca is checking endings. Do your words agree?
probes.quest/16/story: Mojca je ponosna: slovenščina ima dvojino! Dva učenca, dve knjigi, dve besedi. · Mojca is proud: Slovene has the dual! Two pupils, two books, two words.
probes.quest/17/title: Napake na tabli · Mistakes on the blackboard
probes.quest/17/story: Nekdo je na tablo napisal stavke z napakami. Mojca prosi, da jih popraviš. · Someone wrote sentences with mistakes on the blackboard. Mojca asks you to fix them.
probes.quest/18/story: Stari Janez pripoveduje pod lipo, a mu zmanjka besed. Dokončaj njegove stavke. · Old Janez is telling stories under the linden tree, but he runs out of words. Finish his sentences.
probes.quest/19/title: Petkrat na Triglavu · Five times up Triglav
probes.quest/19/story: Janez je bil petkrat na Triglavu. Pravi, da mora vsak Slovenec vsaj enkrat gor. Vprašaj ga, kako je bilo. · Janez has been up Triglav five times. He says every Slovene must go up at least once. Ask him how it was.
probes.quest/20/story: Pod vaško lipo so se nekoč zbirali starešine. Piši Janezu, kaj misliš ti. · Village elders once gathered under the linden tree. Write to Janez what you think.
probes.quest/21/title: Trgatev v Brdih · Grape harvest in Brda
probes.quest/21/story: V Brdih je trgatev. Marko potrebuje pomoč in dober pogovor ob kozarcu rebule. · It is grape harvest in Brda. Marko needs help and a good chat over a glass of rebula.
probes.quest/22/title: Pismo v Gorico · A letter to Gorizia
probes.quest/22/story: Marko prodaja vino tudi čez mejo v Gorici. Napiši mu kratko pismo za kupca. · Marko sells wine across the border in Gorizia too. Write him a short letter for a customer.
probes.quest/23/story: V gostilni v Trnovem čakajo gostje iz Nemčije. Prevajaj zanje. · Guests from Germany are waiting at the inn in Trnovo. Translate for them.
probes.quest/24/story: V gostilno pridejo novi gostje. Pozdravi jih in se jim predstavi. · New guests arrive at the inn. Greet them and introduce yourself.
probes.quest/25/title: Prosim in hvala · Please and thank you
probes.quest/25/story: Vida pravi: „Lepa beseda lepo mesto najde.“ Pomagaj ji vljudno postreči gostom. · Vida says: “A kind word finds a good place” (a Slovene proverb). Help her serve the guests politely.

probes.spot/kopa/label: ♨️ Oglarska kopa · The charcoal pile | pri kopi · by the charcoal pile | Kopa tli, iz lesa nastaja oglje · The pile smoulders: the wood turns into charcoal
probes.spot/kopa/story/A1:
To je oglarska kopa. Oglar zloži drva v velik kup in ga pokrije z zemljo. Kopa ne gori, samo počasi tli. Teden ali dva se iz nje kadi. Potem je les črn in lahek: to je oglje. Oglje gre h kovaču Tonetu, za ogenj v kovačnici.
This is a charcoal pile. The charcoal burner stacks wood in a big heap and covers it with earth. The pile doesn't burn, it only smoulders slowly. For a week or two it smokes. Then the wood is black and light: that is charcoal. The charcoal goes to Tone the smith, for the fire in his smithy.
probes.spot/kopa/story/A2:
Nekoč so v gozdovih nad vasjo delali oglarji. Poleti so nasekali bukova drva in jih zložili v kopo, okrog kola na sredini. Kopo so pokrili z rušo in zemljo, da ni imela preveč zraka, in jo prižgali od zgoraj. Oglar je spal v koči zraven kope in pazil nanjo dan in noč: če bi zagorela, bi ostal samo pepel. Po dveh tednih so kopo razkopali. Oglje so prodali kovačem, tudi našemu Tonetu, in ga nosili v mesta, v Gorico in vse do Trsta.
Long ago charcoal burners worked in the woods above the village. In summer they cut beech wood and stacked it into a pile, around a pole in the middle. They covered the pile with turf and earth, so it wouldn't get too much air, and lit it from the top. The burner slept in a hut beside the pile and watched it day and night: if it caught fire, only ash would be left. After two weeks they opened the pile. They sold the charcoal to the smiths, our Tone too, and carried it to the towns, to Gorizia and all the way to Trieste.
